verses.text: Ix lolon Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés ayik ix lajwi scham chawanh heb' yuninal winhaj Aarón, yujto ix skomon nitzejb'at sb'a heb' t'a slak'anil Jehová,

ix yalan t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: Al t'a winh uk'tak aj Aarón to max komon och winh t'a yol hin kajnub' t'a jun lugar Wiknhej Yaji, haton jun lugar ay t'a spatikoch k'apak cortina. Max yal-laj skomon k'och winh b'aj ay smakul b'aj tz'ak'ji tup mul, haton smakul te' skaxa'il hin trato, yik max cham winh, yujto ha hin ol hin ch'ox hin b'a t'a skal asun t'a yib'anh smakul skaxa'il hin trato chi'.
Ayik tz'och winhaj Aarón t'a yol jun lugar chi', yowalil syik'kot junok nok' kelem wakax winh yik tz'och silab'ok yuj smul yet' junok nok' ch'ak kalnel snhusjitz'a smasanil.

Syak'och spichul winh nab'a lino, haton spichul winh jukan, yol swex winh, k'apak stzek'ul snanhal winh yet' sb'ak'ul sjolom winh. Ha juntzanh pichul chi' te niwan yelk'ochi, yuj chi' b'ab'el sb'ikel sb'a winh ichato chi' syak'anoch winh.
Haxo heb' heyetisraelal syik'kot chawanhok nok' mam chiwa heb' yik tz'ak'ji nok' silab'il yuj smul heb', syik'paxkot junok nok' ch'ak kalnel heb' yik snhusjitz'a'ok.
Syik'ankot nok' kelem wakax chi' winhaj Aarón chi' yik tz'och nok' silab'ok yuj smul. Ha jun nok' chi' yik nok' winh, yuj yak'ji tup smul winh yet' masanil heb' ayek' t'a yol spat.
Slajwi chi' syik'anpaxkot chawanh nok' mam chiwa chi' winh t'a yichanh hin kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox hin b'a.
Syak'anoch suerte winh t'a yib'anh nok' chiwa chi' schawanhil: Jun nok' tz'ak'ji silab'ok t'ayin, haxo junxo nok', tz'ak'chajkanoch mul t'a yib'anh nok', spechchajkanb'at nok' t'a tzinan lu'um.
Ha nok' tz'em suerte t'a yib'anh to wiko', syik'kot nok' winhaj Aarón chi' silab'ok yik stupkanel smul heb' israel.
Haxo junxo nok' chiwa chi', t'a spitzanil nok' tz'och t'a wichanh, tz'ak'jikanoch mul t'a yib'anh nok', tz'aktajkanb'at nok' t'a tzinan lu'um syik'ankanb'at smul heb' israel chi' nok'.
Ayik listaxo yaj juntzanh tik smasanil, smilancham nok' kelem wakax winhaj Aarón chi', syak'an nok' winh silab'il yik tz'ak'ji tup smul yet' smul masanil heb' ayek' yet' winh t'a yol spat.

Slajwi chi', syik'ankot jun chaynub' yik incienso winh, b'ut'an yet' stzak'ak'il altar ay t'a wichanh yet' cha b'echanhok incienso suk'uk'i sjab', syik'anoch winh t'a yoloch k'apak cortina ayoch t'a snanhal hin kajnub'.

Syak'anem incienso chi' winh t'a yib'anh tzak'ak' t'a wichanh, haxo t'a yib'anh smakul b'aj tz'ak'ji tup mul, haton smakul skaxa'il hin trato, tz'och moyan stab'il incienso chi' yik wach' max cham winh.

Syik'ankot jab'ok schik'il nok' kelem wakax chi' winh, slab'anem yiximal sk'ab' winh t'a skal chik' chi', stzikanb'at winh t'a yib'anh smakul kaxa chi' b'aj tz'ochk'och winh chi', ukel stzikoch chik' chi' winh t'a yichanh smakul chi'.

Slajwi chi', tz'elxita winh, smilancham nok' chiwa winh, haton nok' tz'och silab'il yuj smul heb' israel, syik'anoch schik'il nok' winh t'a yoloch k'apak cortina chi', stzikanpaxem schik'il nok' chi' winh t'a yib'anh smakul kaxa chi' yet' t'a yichanh, icha syutej schik'il nok' kelem wakax winh t'a sb'ab'elal.

Icha wal chi' syutej winhaj Aarón chi' sakb'itan jun lugar Wiknhej Yaji yuj yalxonhej tas chukal yet' spitalil heb' israel tik. Icha chi' ol aj sakb'ikan masanil hin kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox hin b'a, haton jun ayek' heyet'ok t'a skal chukal tze k'ulej.

Malaj junok mach ayek' t'a yol hin kajnub' yakb'an ayoch winhaj Aarón chi' t'a jun lugar Wiknhej Yaji yik syak'an silab' winh yik stup smul yet' smul masanil heb' ayek' yet' winh t'a yol spat yet' smul heb' chonhab' masanil.

Slajwi yelxita winh, sakb'itan altar winh ayek' t'a wichanh, haton b'aj snhusjitz'a silab', syik'anelta jab'ok schik'il nok' wakax chi' winh yet' jab'ok yik nok' mam chiwa, syak'anoch winh t'a sch'ak altar ay t'a schikin schanhil.
Stzikanoch ukel schik'il nok' nok' chi' winh yet' yiximal sk'ab' t'a yib'anh altar chi', icha chi' tz'aj sakb'itan altar chi' winh yuj he mul ha hex israel hex tik.
Slajwi sakb'ikan jun lugar Wiknhej Yaji, hin kajnub' yet' pax altar yuj winh, schekan winh ik'jokkot nok' mam chiwa pitzan chi'.

Slajwi chi', syak'anb'at sk'ab' winh schab'il t'a sjolom nok', tz'och ijan winh yalanem smul yet' spitalil heb' yetchonhab' t'a yib'anh nok'. Icha chi' tz'aj skan smul heb' t'a yib'anh nok'. Haxo jun winh sik'b'ilxo'el b'at ak'ankan nok' t'a tzinan lu'um b'aj te najat.
Stijankanb'at nok' winh ta', satkanb'at nok' t'a takinh lum chi'. Icha chi' tz'aj yik'jikanb'at smul chonhab' Israel yuj nok', haton b'aj manhxalaj anima tz'ek'i.

Slajwi chi' tz'ochixta winhaj Aarón t'a yol hin kajnub' yik sk'exanel spichul winh ayochi, k'apak nab'a lino, k'apak ayoch yuj winh ha tz'ochta t'a yol jun lugar to Wiknhej Yaji, syak'ankan k'apak winh ta'.

Hanheja' t'a yol hin kajnub' chi' sb'ikel sb'a winh, syak'anoch spichul winh syak'taxonoch t'a yopisio. Slajwi chi', snhusantz'a silab' winh, haton yik winh yet' silab' yik heb' israel chi' smasanil. Icha chi' tz'aj stupkanel smul winh yet' yik heb' yetchonhab' chi'.
Ha jantak xepu'al nok' silab' yuj mul, snhusjipaxtz'a t'a yib'anh altar.
Haxo winh b'at ak'ankan nok' mam chiwa t'a takinh lum chi', ayik sjax winh, sjuk'el spichul winh, sb'ikanpaxel sb'a winh. Ichato chi' syal yochta winh t'a yol campamento.

Ha nok' kelem wakax yet' nok' mam chiwa smiljicham silab'il yuj stupkanel mul, haton nok' tz'ik'jikot schik'il t'a yol jun lugar to Wiknhej Yaji, tz'ik'jikanb'at sniwanil nok' t'a spatikel campamento. Hata' snhusjitz'a nok' yet' stz'umal yet' masanil sniwanil.
Ha winh snhusantz'a nok' chi', yowalil sjuk'el spichul winh, sb'ikanpaxel sb'a winh, ichato chi' syal yochta winh t'a yol campamento.

Ha jun tik ley tz'ajkan t'a he kal t'a masanil tiempo hex israel hex, ma heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a he kal. Ha t'a slajunhil k'uhal t'a yukil uj, tzex och t'a tzek'ojk'olal, malaj mach smunlaj t'a jun k'uhal chi',
yujto ha jun k'uhal chi', sk'uhal yak'ji silab' yuj he mul yik wach' stupkanel he mul t'a wichanh.
Ha jun k'uhal chi', sk'uhal ik'oj ip tz'ajkani yet' tzek'ojk'olal, ley tz'ajkan t'a he kal t'a masanil tiempo.

Ha yuj chi' ha ol cham winh sat sacerdote, haxo junok heb' yuninal winh tz'ochkan sk'exulok. Tz'ak'chajk'e aceite t'a sjolom, tz'ak'jipax silab' yuj yochkan yopisio, syak'anoch spichul te niwan yelk'ochi.
Ha tz'ak'an silab' yik sakb'itan jun lugar to Wiknhej Yaji, hin kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox hin b'a yet' altar. Syak'anpax silab' yik stup smul heb' sacerdote yet' hex israel hex tik.

Ha jun tik ley tz'ajkan t'a he kal t'a masanil tiempo. Jun'el tz'ak'ji silab' tik t'a yol junjun ab'il yik slajwi'el he mul ha hex chonhab' israel hex tik, xchi Jehová. Icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová, icha chi' ix yutej winhaj Moisés chi' yalani.
